summary: [f1] blocking: exactChange claims it can safely fall back to report.FromDiff when FromCapture detects a mismatch. (internal/workflow/engine.go: exactChange and runCandidate) — The architectural plan explicitly requires structural mismatches to fail closed. This code instead accepts the reviewed candidate, emits a status event, then records a report and decision using the known-lossy parser—the exact authority bypass this change is meant to eliminate. Sensei’s current high-confidence preflight identifies the critical candidate-evidence and authority invariants, and its architect guidance specifically calls out “fallback-as-truth” as a failure mode to challenge. → Propagate the FromCapture error out of the final-candidate path (or recapture after validation so the final diff and exact Paths are from one capture), and do not call emitChangeReport or recordDecision unless the exact Change was constructed successfully.
